note: City of Orange City park at 810 5th St SW. Campground sits beside Veteran's Park with its pickleball courts, skate park, ball fields, hitting cage and basketball hoops; dog park to the north. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 8 cement pads, A-E full 30/50, F-G no sewer, H tent; showers; May 1-Nov 1; non-refundable online booking; 14 nights. Fee is posted as a $5-$20 range, so only the high is written. Website moved.
